title: How do you install GenStone panels on a chimney? - GenStone
text:
How do you install GenStone panels on a chimney?

Chimney installs do not require flashing. Follow GenStone installation instructions, including using the proper amount of adhesive and caulking all connections between panels and all termination points. Fasten to the appropriate surface using the recommended fasteners for your substrate.
